title: aconitum variegatum subsp. rostratum
intro: Aconitum variegatum subsp. rostratum, commonly known as the Ferox Larkspur, is a plant species belonging to the Aconitum genus, characterized by its tall, upright stems and blue-violet flowers. The health benefits of Aconitum variegatum subsp. rostratum include its potential use in treating pain and inflammation, as well as its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, making it a useful treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Aconitum variegatum subsp. rostratum include alkaloids, such as aconitine, mesaconitine, and hypaconitine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
